policy: Every sound in a PrayogX reel is listed here with its provenance. audio.py refuses any asset that is not listed, whose licenseVerified is not true, that does not permit commercial use on Instagram, or (for a file) whose sha256 does not match. Never add film or film songs, chart music, trending Instagram audio, random YouTube or 'free music' downloads, or any track whose commercial social-media licence cannot be verified from a written licence kept with the file. If the licence cannot be verified, do not use the asset. An external voiceover (role voice, source external-tts) is allowed only through this list: a verified licence document kept in the repository, commercial use for the platform, the standard disclosureText, and per reel a VERIFIED voice record that references this assetId (tools/reel-maker/README.md -> Voiceover).

assets.license: PrayogX original work: composed and synthesized in-house by code for each reel (oscillators, additive partials and filtered noise). No samples, loops, presets or third-party recordings are used.
